# Security Checklist: Instalação e configuração (install-and-setup)

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade dos requisitos de segurança da 002 (atualização automática, rede só no app, gravação
na configuração da Steam com cópia e desfazer, soltar/reanexar só leitura) antes do plano
**Created**: 2026-11-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: Standard · Audience: Reviewer (PR)

## Atualização automática

- [ ] CHK001 Is the threat the update hash check protects against (corruption vs. a malicious release from whoever controls the releases repository) stated, with the accepted risk or the countermeasure documented? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK002 Is the rule for a download whose hash differs from the published one specified (discard, never install)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK003 Is the update source limited to one named public releases repository over HTTPS? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined against installing an older version (downgrade)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-032]
- [x] CHK005 Is the behavior for an interrupted download specified, so nothing half-downloaded installs? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Is it stated that an update never installs while the keeper runs the game? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK007 Is the unsigned installer (SmartScreen) an explicit, documented decision with the user instruction? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Rede

- [x] CHK008 Is the set of components allowed to reach the network listed, and are the keeper, the reader and the game explicitly excluded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK009 Can "only the update check reaches the network" be measured in a session? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK010 Is the constitution amendment that allows this network access a documented dependency, with where it lands? [Dependency, Spec §Dependências]

## Configuração da Steam

- [x] CHK011 Is every change to Steam tied to an explicit user action, with no automatic path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK012 Is the scope of the write limited to the launch option of Legends of Idleon, leaving the rest of the file untouched? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK013 Are the backup location, how many copies and their lifetime specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK014 Is undo defined to remove only the companion's part of the current text, for every configured account, in Settings and in the uninstaller? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK015 Is it forbidden to kill the Steam process or write its file while it runs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK016 Is the behavior for an unreadable or unexpected Steam file specified (write nothing)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Is the account data the companion stores minimized, and kept out of logs? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK018 Is it specified that an existing launch option is never erased, only added to, with the current and new texts shown? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]

## Soltar e reanexar

- [x] CHK019 Do detach and reattach carry the 001 read-only constraints (no game function called, nothing written to the save)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK020 Is it stated that the debugging pipe stays open on detach, so the game does not crash? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK021 Do the new window actions follow the 001 IPC rules (fixed channels, sender check, shape check)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-030]

## Instalação

- [x] CHK022 Is the install per user, without administrator rights, at a fixed path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK023 Is it stated that the installer carries no game files? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK001 tem uma linha `open` em Open Questions.
